snippet.title: Toiletocalypse - Legion Go RAW Gameplay (I failed almost every run)
snippet.description:
Raw gameplay of Toiletocalypse on Legion Go (controller).

Mostly 10-minute shifts + one 20-minute attempt.
I lost almost every run. Only one survived.

Expect:
- Multiple vomiting moments in a row
- Failing under pressure
- Random events
- One run where I didn’t even get a kettle

This game is harder than it looks.

Toiletocalypse is an absurd survival roguelike where you try to finish your work shift while managing hydration, pressure, and sanity.

Wishlist / Buy:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4982780/Toiletocalypse/
